Ah, but the punishment! One thundering word has brought me to my knees. Equal to you? No. The power to summon you here? Yes: Yes, that I had. But not the power to hold you. O that moment! That supreme moment when at once I felt so great and so small! And then to be thrust back, ruthlessly, into uncertainty, the fated lot of man. Who will teach me? What must I shun? Do I deny my urge, my quest to seek the source of all life? Ah, not only the deeds we do, but those done fo us, turn us from our goal. Our mind’s most glorious thoughts are forever violated by the vulgar dross of matter. Once we achieve the good of this world, ideals are despised and deemed illusion, and only comfort serves. Noble sentiments that once were life’s breath are drowned in earthly 卡俄斯. There was a time when the winged and hopeful flight of imagination soared out into infinity; but now, when misfortunes come, one after another, a tiny space is all it needs.
translation:
@@U00150@@
啊，但是惩罚！一声雷鸣般的话语让我跪了下来。和你一样吗？不，有能力召唤你来这里？是的：是的，我有过。但没有力量来束缚你。噢，那一刻！那个至高无上的时刻，我立刻感到如此伟大又如此渺小！然后被无情地推回不确定的境地，这就是人类的命运。谁来教我？我必须避免什么？我是否否认我对寻找所有生命之源的渴望和追求？啊，不仅我们所做的事，而且那些为我们所做的事，都使我们偏离了我们的目标。我们心灵最辉煌的思想永远被庸俗的物质渣滓所侵犯。一旦我们实现了这个世界的美好，理想就会被鄙视，被视为幻想，只有舒适才能发挥作用。曾经是生命气息的高贵情感被尘世的卡俄斯淹没了。曾经有一段时间，想象的翅膀和希望飞翔到无限。但现在，当不幸接连发生时，它所需要的只是一个小小的空间。
